title: Manager - Data Engineering and Analytics
jobDescription: Job Responsibilities: Manage and mentor a team of Power BI developers and Snowflake data engineers, ensuring high-quality deliverables and professional growth Partner with internal IT business application managers who serve as IT partners to functions such as Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, R&D, and Finance to understand data and analytics needs Ensure uptime, reliability, and smooth performance of Snowflake (data platform) and Power BI (analytics/reporting) environments Drive an Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE) for the IT function — continuously scout, evaluate, and onboard better solutions and vendors to improve the company's analytics landscape Define the enterprise data architecture framework, including security, reference data, metadata, and master data standards Define and implement a roadmap for Data Lifecycle Management and Self-Service Analytics across the organization Run the Master Data Management (MDM) CoE across the organization — ensure master data integrity and quality across all systems Identify data sources (internal and external) and develop a systematic plan for data management, including API frameworks for data retrieval Conduct continuous audits of the data management system covering performance, cost usage, and security — report any breaches or loopholes immediately to stakeholders Own cost management of data hosting vis-à-vis the technology stack, mapped with the lifecycle of data Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors for smooth functioning of the enterprise data ecosystem Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members on best practices, tools, and emerging trends Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors for smooth functioning of the enterprise data system. Provide training to other team members on best practices

title: Senior Safety Officer
jobDescription: ENVIRONMENT MANAGEMENT: · Identification of Environmental issues. · Managing the integral environmental protection program having as guidelines: ISO 14001, corporate policies and environmental regulations. · Waste water control and its assessment. · Releases to atmosphere control by regular monitoring of ambient air and stack emission. · Hazardous waste management. · Operation and maintenance of ETP, STP and Zero Discharge Plant to meeting State pollution control board’s norms for waste water recycling. · Prepare daily ETP test report, monthly water balance, and monthly waste report and prepare action plan for its reduction. · Conducting environment monitoring. SAFETY MANAGEMENT: Safety Culture Building Analyse behaviour of the people in plant toward safety and devise strategies to change behaviour Devise site reward & recognition schemes to promote Safe Behaviour Training Decide safety training strategy for the site and coach officers/Sr. officers, HR team in preparing safety training calendar for Workmen, Execs, Managers & contractual employees Conduct training of necessary stakeholders in areas of Safety Standards, Work Permit Systems, Risk Assessment, Emergency Plan Devise a system & allocate responsibility to conduct safety briefing to all contractual employees Statutory Compliances Responsible for overall EHS related Statutory compliances for the site Dealing with Factory inspector, PCB, and building positive rapport Prepare a list of all Statutory Requirements related to Safety , allocate responsibility & develop a mechanism for tracking Internal Audits To develop a calendar for conducting Safety Audits in plant, allocate responsibility & track compliances Highlight key audit findings to site leadership and get the audit gasps closed with functional stakeholders Safety Risk Assessment /Emergency Plan Train the functional stakeholders on Emergency preparedness and response Conduct Emergency Mock-Drills as per requirement · Periodic eview of Risk Assessment & Emergency Plan. Hazard Identification & Mitigation / Accident Investigation Coach to devise a system of spotting and reporting Hazards and mitigation of same· Train the functional stakeholders on various Risk Assessment tools such as HIRA, JSA etc. Ensure compliance to Accident reporting and Investigation protocol. HEALTH AND HYGIENE: · Managing the occupational health program. Regular monitoring of Noise level, Illumination level, and VOC level in the plant. · Continuous training to the workers exposed to chemicals using MSDS and other tools.
